title: TCPCL: Fix signed overflow UB
description:
Calling tvb_reported_length_remaining before increasing offset is better
than adding to offset and comparing to a fixed tvb_reported_length
obtained at the beginning. The former does automatic overflow checks.

OSS-Fuzz 444479892
Fix #20711
